[USER] User asks for examples of extensions mentioned and which are most effective.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Examples of extensions:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Pocket: A bookmarking extension that saves web pages and recommends similar content.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. StumbleUpon: A recommendation-based extension suggesting new websites based on interests.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Evernote Web Clipper: A bookmarking extension that saves pages and allows tagging and notes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Reddit Enhancement Suite: A social media extension enhancing Reddit experience with similar subreddits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Feedly: A news aggregator extension collecting news and stories from various websites.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Effectiveness of extensions depends on individual preferences and browsing habits.
